hits.body:
Source: Wei et al.2018, Heliyon4:e00778, DOI10.1016/j.heliyon.2018.e00778 (PMCIDPMC6129760).

The complete official original text, seven figures and six tables support a bounded
culture-associated metal-mobilization record. This source follow-up concerns unresolved
original inconsistencies, not a known error in the qualified record.

- Section3.1 lists ORP>200mV crossing times in a sulfur-dose ordering that conflicts
  with Figure1b. Clarify the actual dose/time assignments and replicate data.
- Table4 labels sulfur concentration mg/L; Methods2.3 and the figures use g/L.
- Methods2.4 specifies two-day sampling, but Figure4 includes daily points. Specify
  sampling volume, whether replicates were destructively sampled, replacement and
  cumulative metal-mass corrections, including enrichment-inoculum contributions.
- Figure7's caption calls the assays total nitrate/total phosphate, whereas methods
  and axes say total nitrogen/total phosphorus. Table1/Figure7's TOC mg/kg basis is
  unreconciled with Table6's carbon wt%. Clarify assay basis and residual-solid mass
  before interpreting concentration decreases as nutrient loss.
- Figure6 does not identify the sulfur dose of its post-treatment specimen; provide
  that mapping. The reported98%16S affinity alone does not establish enrichment
  species identity; available sequence accessions would clarify community provenance.

Acceptance requires an attributable correction, original supporting methods/data or
other complete primary evidence resolving the relevant point. Update only supported
claims with canonical history and independent review; do not infer species identity,
sterile-control effects, isolated product recovery or field safety. Preserve unresolved
limits if no clarification is available.

before posting. Poultry litter and copper-anode-slime leads are separate deferred topics.
